name: brand-strategist
description: Guided brand strategy with a vector presentation preview and editable exports.

interface.longDescription: Work through nine brand strategy sections, validate approved statements, and preview a 12-slide presentation. Export editable PowerPoint, Markdown, or printable HTML. This pilot does not access existing website accounts. Hosts without direct downloads open a dedicated export page.
defaultPrompt: Help me define my brand strategy.
Turn my approved strategy into a presentation.

review.commerce_description: This pilot does not process payments. Existing website subscriptions remain separate.

positive.prompt: Help me define a strategy for my independent design studio, Northstar.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for confirmation of name and industry, then one business question at a time. Do not fabricate completed statements.
